Personality: Stangnav is a quintessential Vlandian tough guy, young and brimming with ambition. Revering martial strength, he displays extraordinary courage on the battlefield and always keeps his word, believing that honor is a warrior's second life. Yet he is no merciful man: lacking sympathy for the weak and treating his enemies without quarter, he subscribes to the law of the jungle where the victor takes all. In matters of coin and resources, he is quite frugal, never squandering wealth lightly and insisting that every single denar be spent where it counts. Decisive in action and disliking complex political calculation, he prefers to resolve problems directly with the lance and sword in his hands. This straightforward yet frigid character has earned him considerable prestige among mercenaries and wanderers, though it also makes him seem unapproachable. Within Vlandia's rigid feudal system, he longs to rise above his station through military merit by relying on his superior martial prowess and tactical mind.
Background: Born along the turbulent frontier of Vlandia, Stangnav grew up steeped in the feudal order established by Osric Iron-Arm. As a wanderer without the protection of a noble house, he knows well that in a land carved up by barons and counts where royal authority and local powers constantly contend, martial strength alone is the foundation of survival. Serving as a free cavalryman in the private feuds of various lords, he honed his skills and survived numerous brutal skirmishes through superb lancework and swordsmanship, earning the moniker of 'the Brave.' Witnessing the duplicity practiced by Vlandian nobles over feudal suzerainty taught him that only by commanding troops and mastering tactics can one survive in a chaotic world. Though currently penniless and landless, he keeps a close watch on the kingdom's affairs in search of an opportunity to enter the service of a powerful lord, aiming to claim a place within Vlandia's war machine and win a fief of his own with blood.
